caketext_translator.title: CakeText Translator
caketext_translator.status.dictionary: Dictionary: %s strings in %s files · model cache: %s
caketext_translator.model.missing: Local model not installed (download about %s MB)
caketext_translator.marker.machine_note: Made by a small model on your PC, so it may be wrong.
caketext_translator.option.enabled.tip: Show server text in your language.
caketext_translator.option.machine.tip: Lines no string file translates yet are translated by %s on your PC, in the background. They show in English until it's done.
caketext_translator.option.quality.tip: Best: about 0.6 s a line, closest to the full model. Fast: about 0.1 s a line, a bit rougher. Lines are translated once and remembered.
caketext_translator.option.markers.tip: An icon on translated text: a book for string translations, a chip for the model. In chat, hover it to see the source and the original.
caketext_translator.option.tooltip_foote: A line at the bottom of item tooltips saying where the translations came from.
caketext_translator.option.model_install: Downloads opus-mt-en-zh (Helsinki-NLP, Apache-2.0) from Hugging Face, checks it, and converts it to an int8 file of about 75 MB. Uses about 110 MB of memory while loaded.
caketext_translator.surfaces.title: Where to translate
caketext_translator.command.model_instal: Downloading the model (%s MB) in the background. /cttranslate status shows progress.
caketext_translator.command.test_none: Not in any string file, and the model isn't ready.
caketext_translator.command.test_queued: Not in any string file; asking the model…
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.caketext-: Translates server text from string files, and with a local opus-mt model for strings that aren't translated yet. An icon shows where each translation came from.
caketext_translator.option.display.tip: Tooltips: Translation, Both (translation, then the original in grey) or Original (translation in grey below). Scoreboard, titles, boss bars, nameplates and the action bar show the translation unless set to Original.
caketext_translator.option.player_chat.t: What other players say is translated by the local model. Only the message: channel tags, rank and name stay as they are. These translations are kept in memory only, never written to disk.
caketext_translator.option.player_chat_d: Original (default): what they wrote; hover it to see the translation. Translation: hover to see what they wrote. Both: the translation, then the original in grey.
caketext_translator.engine.title: Translation engine
caketext_translator.option.engine_type.t: What translates lines no string file has. opus-mt: small model built into the mod (download below). Local server: a bigger model you run yourself, e.g. Hunyuan-MT-7B in Ollama; better translations, needs a GPU with about 8 GB.
caketext_translator.option.protocol.tip: Ollama: default address http://127.0.0.1:11434. OpenAI-compatible: llama.cpp llama-server (start it with --jinja, port 8080) or LM Studio (port 1234).
caketext_translator.option.server_url.ti: Where the server listens. Keep it on 127.0.0.1 (this PC): every line to translate, including player chat, is sent there.
As the server names it. For Hunyuan-MT-7B in Ollama run: ollama pull hf.co/mradermacher/Hunyuan-MT-7B-GGUF:Q4_K_M (4.3 GB). Hunyuan-MT is under the Tencent Hunyuan Community License, which doesn't cover the EU, UK or South Korea.
Saves these settings and asks the server now. The status line above shows the answer.
caketext_translator.server.no_model: connected, but it has no model %s
caketext_translator.option.item_names.ti: Off (default): the first tooltip line, the item's name, stays as the server sends it, the name other players, the trade market and wikis use. Lore and stats below it are still translated.
Server messages in chat. Original (default): the message as sent; hover it to see the translation. Translation: hover to see the original. Both: the translation, then the original in grey.
caketext_translator.option.cache_clear.t: Forgets everything the current engine translated (its _machine file), so lines are translated again, e.g. after a better engine or prompt.
